THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Two Allotments of land in total extent of about 2.7572 Hectaresdepicted in the Advance Tracing No. Ma/MNN/2017/097 and dated28.03.2018, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Villagecalled Uvari, in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/60 ofOlaittoduvai in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mannar Townof Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Uvarinilam – Extent: 0.3924 HectareNorth: Uvarinilam, claimant not known, claimed by Seylan Business(Pvt) Ltd and Lot B; East: Lot B, Uvarinilam, claimed by Shell CoastResort and Lanka CZ (Pvt) Ltd., and claimant not known; South:Uvarinilam claimant not known and Beach; West: Beach andUvarinilam claimant not known.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Uvarinilam – Extent: 2.3648 Hectare
North: Uvarinilam, claimed by Seylan Business (Pvt) Ltd; East:
Uvarinilam, claimed by Seylan Business (Pvt) Ltd and claimed by
Shell Coast Resort and Lanka CZ (Pvt) Ltd; South: Uvarinilam claimed
by Shell Coast Resort and Lanka CZ (Pvt) Ltd, claimant not known
and Lot A; West: Lot A, Uvarinilam claimant not known and claimed
by Seylan Business (Pvt) Ltd.

Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
